verify_command_contract: bash; needs jq, psql and DATABASE_URL in env; exit 0 = cell proven (record_id set in this file AND >=1 compliance.audit_logs row for that id tagged details->>'surface'=<surface> with a non-null user_id and null api_key_id); today every cell exits non-zero at jq -e because record_id is null. Prerequisite not met today: no writer stamps a surface key into compliance.audit_logs.details (a TEXT column, not jsonb) and audit_logs has no surface column. SQL body validated live 2026-09-25 on pcrjmlpuqsbocqfwoxod with a literal id (returned count 0, no error). (2026-09-25, U-20a/U-20b: an audit row written on an API key carries BOTH the key and the acting person, so a cell no longer requires api_key_id to be null; it requires user_id to be set.)
